mentions.heading: Reliance on foreign operations and suppliers exposes us to foreign risks
mentions.risk_name: Natural disaster and political instability at facilities
mentions.detail: Assembly, test and finished goods warehouses near Bangkok, Thailand; past flooding and political instability
mentions.quote: In addition, we own product assembly and testing facilities, and finished goods warehouses near Bangkok, Thailand, which has experienced periods of political instability and severe flooding in the past.

mentions.detail: China-Taiwan relations could disrupt Taiwan-based third-party wafer foundries and subcontractors
mentions.quote: political instability, including changes in relations between China and Taiwan which could disrupt the operations of our Taiwan-based third-party wafer foundries, and subcontractors;

mentions.heading: Reliance on foreign operations and suppliers exposes us to foreign risks
mentions.detail: Currency controls in China could affect amount and timing of customer payments
mentions.quote: restrictions on the transfer of funds, including currency controls in China, which could negatively affect the amount and timing of certain customer payments, and as a results our cash flows;

mentions.heading: Geopolitical instability in the Middle East may disrupt critical semiconductor materials
mentions.detail: Qatar supplies over one-third of helium; Iranian drone strikes halted facilities; two-thirds of bromine from Israel and Jordan
mentions.quote: For example, Qatar accounts for more than one‑third of the world’s helium production, and recent Iranian drone strikes halted operations at major helium facilities.

mentions.heading: Geopolitical instability in the Middle East may increase fuel costs
mentions.detail: Middle East conflict raises fuel prices; ocean, air and trucking logistics face surcharges, rerouting and delays
mentions.quote: Significant increases in fuel costs, reductions in carrier capacity, or extended transit times could materially increase our transportation and distribution expenses.
